cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: The Logic Gets Bigger
cards.instruction: Use every new detail to expand the impossible system, its history, and the consequences of breaking it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Our soup bowl said hello. Use the formal greeting; crockery stopped speaking after the Great Washing-Up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Trade has reopened. Offer a roll, but keep the butter separate; mixed gifts caused the gravy embargo.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's asking for a seat at dinner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's recognition as a nation. Move the plates apart before we accidentally concede its borders.

mechanism: A copies a bowl tap as a diplomatic greeting and expands each food request into invented crockery history and territorial consequences.
confusable: D168 grows a system history with new detail; D145 simply makes impossible hospitality ordinary.
comparison: Office jurisdiction expansion versus dinner turning into diplomacy.
seedUse: Keep bread/trade and seat/recognition, but give the final place-setting choice a legible border consequence.
